source: Aswath Damodaran, valuation packet 2 (spring 2021), NYU Stern. US PE summary statistics across 7,584 firms; regional EV/EBITDA medians at the start of 2021; global price-to-book medians, January 2013.
refresh: https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/ — the annual data update carries current multiples by industry and by region. These distributions move far enough year to year to reverse a verdict, so refresh before quoting a percentile.
threshold_warning: A fixed threshold decays. 6x EBITDA sat in the modal US bucket (4-6x) in January 2010 and so was not cheap; by January 2021 the US median was 16.6x and the same 6x was below the 10th percentile. Locate a multiple in the current, local distribution before calling it high or low.
cross_market_warning: Medians differ across markets because the underlying fundamentals differ — interest rates, real growth, country risk, accounting for goodwill and buybacks, and index composition. A gap between two markets' medians is not a trade until those differences are priced.

us_current_pe_2021.description: US current PE (last fiscal year EPS), January 2021. 2,780 of 7,584 firms had a usable multiple; the mean was 109.79 and the maximum 36,157.
us_current_pe_2021.truncation_note: About two-thirds of US firms had no usable current PE. Any conclusion drawn from this distribution describes the profitable subsample.

us_trailing_pe_2021.description: US trailing PE (trailing twelve months), January 2021. 2,481 of 7,584 firms had a usable multiple; the mean was 103.25 against a median of 20.30.
us_trailing_pe_2021.truncation_note: The mean sits above the 90th percentile. Only about a third of US firms had positive trailing earnings, so the sample excludes every money-losing firm.

us_forward_pe_2021.description: US forward PE (next-year forecast EPS), January 2021. 2,354 of 7,584 firms had a usable multiple; the mean was 79.74.
us_forward_pe_2021.truncation_note: Forward PE is less skewed than trailing PE because forecast earnings smooth a bad year, but the drop-out rate is just as high.

regional_ev_ebitda_median_2021.description: Median EV/EBITDA by region, start of 2021.

regional_pbv_median_2013.description: Median price-to-book by region, January 2013. Japan's persistent discount is the standing exam question: cheap, or justified by low ROE?
